topic.title: Dynamic 3D Reconstruction and Geometrically Consistent Video
topic.overview: Reconstructing a moving scene from ordinary video requires separating camera motion, object motion, and changing shape. This topic studies representations and priors that maintain correspondence across frames, as well as ways to impose geometric consistency on generated video. A convincing individual image is insufficient when the scene must remain coherent through time.
topic.whyItMatters: Dynamic reconstruction can support scene understanding and controllable visual synthesis, but monocular observations leave important ambiguities. Methods need assumptions about shape, motion, or learned geometry; evaluation must check temporal structure rather than relying only on visual plausibility.
topic.evolution: A 2003 approach constrains nonrigid shapes with a Gaussian model and temporal smoothness. Recent methods use learned point maps, trajectories, flow, and deformable Gaussian representations. Track3R in 2025 separates object and camera trajectories, while VideoGPA in 2026 derives preference signals from a geometry model to encourage more consistent video generation.
openQuestions: How can geometry remain reliable through occlusion and large nonrigid deformation?
Do learned geometric preferences transfer beyond the scenes used to train their evaluator?

papers.tldr: CamGeo distills 3D knowledge into a video generator during training to improve motion consistency under sparse camera guidance without adding inference latency.

papers.title: Crowd4D: Scene-Aware Monocular 4D Crowd Reconstruction
papers.tldr: Crowd4D jointly reconstructs crowds and scene geometry from a single video, improving alignment and motion stability in complex environments.

papers.title: De4D-SLAM: Gradient-Isolated Static-Dynamic Decoupling for Monocular SLAM in Dynamic Environments
papers.tldr: De4D-SLAM separates static and dynamic learning signals to support camera tracking and changing-scene reconstruction without object-category priors.

papers.title: DiffCrossGait: Trajectory-Level Alignment for 2D-3D Cross-Modal Gait Recognition via Latent Diffusion
papers.tldr: DiffCrossGait aligns silhouette and point-cloud gait features throughout diffusion training without adding iterative denoising at inference.

papers.title: DynaTok: Token-Based 4D Reconstruction from Partial Point Clouds
papers.tldr: DynaTok reconstructs complete, temporally coherent 3D sequences from partial point clouds without images or explicit frame-to-frame correspondences.

papers.title: Evaluating Newtonian Mechanics in Video Generative Models with Real Physical Systems
papers.tldr: Morpheus evaluates generated videos against conservation laws and finds persistent physical inconsistencies in controlled Newtonian settings.

papers.title: Flow Equivariant World Models: Structured Memory for Dynamic Environments
papers.tldr: Flow Equivariant World Models transform memory with self-motion and inferred object motion to improve prediction in partially observed environments.

papers.title: Flow for Future: Geometric SE(3)-Equivariant Flow Matching for 3D Trajectory Prediction
papers.tldr: GSE-Flow combines motion history with generative flow matching while guaranteeing consistent predictions under 3D rotations and translations.

papers.title: FunPhase: A Periodic Functional Autoencoder for Motion Generation via Phase Manifolds
papers.tldr: FunPhase learns a continuous phase-based motion representation that supports flexible temporal sampling, prediction, and generation across skeletons.

papers.title: Future Dynamic 3D Reconstruction: Toward 3D World Modeling with Disentangled Ego-Motion
papers.tldr: FR3D forecasts persistent 3D scenes by separating environmental motion from the agent’s own movement and distilling foundation-model spatial knowledge.

papers.title: GemDepth: Geometry-Embedded Features for 3D-Consistent Video Depth
papers.tldr: GemDepth uses camera-motion embeddings to guide video depth prediction toward sharper details and stronger three-dimensional consistency.

papers.title: HieraScaffold: Learning Compact Hierarchical Representations for Scalable 4D LiDAR Generation
papers.tldr: HieraScaffold generates more coherent LiDAR sequences by compactly representing and recombining geometry and motion at multiple scales.

papers.title: Infinite-World: Scaling Interactive World Models to 1000-Frame Horizons via Pose-Free Hierarchical Memory
papers.tldr: Infinite-World combines compressed visual memory, uncertainty-aware actions, and revisit-focused training to sustain coherent interactions beyond 1,000 frames.

papers.title: Kinematics-Driven Gaussian Shape Deformation for Blurry Monocular Dynamic Scenes
papers.tldr: Kinematics-GS uses motion-aligned Gaussian deformation to improve reconstruction of blurry, non-rigid scenes from single-camera video.

papers.title: Learning 3D-Gaussian Simulators from RGB Videos
papers.tldr: 3DGSim learns particle-based 3D dynamics from multi-view videos and produces physically plausible simulations, including reported cases beyond its single-body-collision training.

papers.title: LieWarper: Geometry-Aware Motion Transfer via Lie Algebra
papers.tldr: LieWarper transfers video motion through geometry-aware coordinate evolution, improving trajectory fidelity and structural stability.

papers.title: MAC-NeRF: Motion-Aware Curriculum Learning for Dynamic LiDAR NeRFs
papers.tldr: MAC-NeRF improves dynamic LiDAR scene synthesis by gradually introducing harder motion supervision and finer geometric detail.

papers.title: MVISTA-4D: View-Consistent 4D World Model with Test-Time Action Inference for Robotic Manipulation
papers.tldr: MVISTA-4D generates geometrically consistent evolving scenes from one RGBD view and uses test-time trajectory optimization to infer robot actions.

papers.title: PanoWorld-X: Generating Explorable Panoramic Worlds via Sphere-Aware Video Diffusion
papers.tldr: PanoWorld-X combines panoramic geometry, sphere-aware attention, and 3D motion guidance to generate more controllable explorable visual scenes.

papers.title: Path-Decoupled Hyperbolic Flow Matching for Few-Shot Adaptation
papers.tldr: Hyperbolic Flow Matching separates class-specific feature trajectories and adaptively stops transport, improving reported few-shot adaptation performance.

papers.title: Physics from Video: Identifiability of Time-Invariant Second-Order ODEs under Minimal Trajectory Conditions
papers.tldr: The paper establishes conditions for recovering second-order linear physical laws from video using an encoder without pixel reconstruction.

papers.title: PVDepth: Panoramic Video Depth Estimation via Geometry-Aware Spatiotemporal Adaptation
papers.tldr: PVDepth combines new panoramic training data with sphere-aware initialization and cubemap temporal modeling for accurate, consistent video depth.

papers.title: RealisMotion: Decomposed Human Motion Control and Video Generation in the World Space
papers.tldr: RealisMotion separates subject, background, trajectory, and action controls to generate human videos with editable motion in 3D world space.

papers.title: S2GS: Streaming Semantic Gaussian Splatting for Online Scene Understanding and Reconstruction
papers.tldr: S2GS incrementally reconstructs and labels 3D scenes from image streams, maintaining object identities while substantially improving long-sequence scalability.

papers.title: SceneDirector: Bridging Explicit Geometry and Generative Priors for Unified Driving Scene Editing
papers.tldr: SceneDirector combines a 3D geometric scaffold with source-video textures to jointly edit driving-scene objects and ego trajectories.

papers.title: Taylor-Gaussians-Flow: Towards Non-uniform Motion for Novel View Synthesis from Monocular Video
papers.tldr: Taylor-Gaussians-Flow models second-order motion and separates depth from optical-flow supervision to improve dynamic novel-view synthesis from monocular video.

papers.title: VAnim: Rendering-Aware Sparse State Modeling for Structure-Preserving Vector Animation
papers.tldr: VAnim generates text-controlled SVG animations through sparse updates that preserve structure and learn from rendered visual feedback.

papers.title: VGGT-Motion: Motion-Aware Calibration-Free Monocular SLAM for Long-Range Consistency
papers.tldr: VGGT-Motion reduces long-range monocular SLAM drift through motion-aware submaps, direct anchor alignment, and lightweight global optimization.

papers.title: VideoGPA: Distilling Geometry Priors for 3D-Consistent Video Generation
papers.tldr: VideoGPA uses automatically derived geometric preferences to improve video consistency without human annotations.

papers.title: VividCam: Learning Unconventional Camera Motions from Virtual Synthetic Videos
papers.tldr: VividCam teaches diffusion video models uncommon camera movements from simple synthetic scenes while separating motion from artificial appearance.

papers.title: World-R1: Reinforcing 3D Constraints for Text-to-Video Generation
papers.tldr: World-R1 uses reinforcement learning with 3D and vision-language feedback to improve video geometry while preserving visual quality and the model architecture.
